from django.contrib.auth.decorators import user_passes_test, login_required

from hackingweek.models import Team

has_no_team = user_passes_test(lambda u: u.team_set.all().count() == 0)

    """Decorate a function to make it only accessible to non team members, i.e, those with 0 teams

    decorated_view_func = login_required - 
        user must be logged in to access view.

    has_no_team required - 
        user must have no team to access view.

    view_func - 
        is login_required(has_no_team(view_func))))

    Will decorate your function appropriately.
    """
    decorated_view_func = login_required(has_no_team(view_func))
    return decorated_view_func


has_team = user_passes_test(lambda u: u.team_set.all().count() == 1 or u.is_staff)


def has_team_required(view_func):
    """Decorator to make your view accessible to those currently team members, i.e,

    has_team = user_passes_test(lambda u: u.team_set.all().count() == 1 or u.is_staff)
    will ensure the user has a team, doesn't block users who have multiple amendments you'll need!

    # user must have a team to access the view!
    decorated_view_func = login_required(has_team(view_func))
